rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits high melanin saturation (approximately 80-90%) on the lateral and inferior margins, with a localized area of lighter pink/pale pixels at the superior-central apex of the nose.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark vertical mark or scar is visible on the frontal region, situated superior to the right orbital ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of white periocular fur patches; early-stage mane development along the neck and post-auricular region.
